title: Project
description: Speth's Screens project file — single source of truth. Generated types: internal/project/types.go + packages/shared-types/src/project.ts

pin.description: Operator PIN — operator panel locks behind this if set

viewOnly.description: Disable all write widgets in the operator panel

theme.description: Default theme for every screen. A browser can still pick its own; that choice is not saved in the project

security.description: Login settings. Missing means mode 'none'. Users live on the runtime (security.db), not in the project

historian.description: What the historian stores and for how long. Missing means every change, plus one sample per tag every 60 s, kept for the runtime's --history-retention (default 7 days)

namespace.description: Unified Namespace — flat list of folders, assets and tags. Tags with driverId+driverAddr are bound to a live datasource

enabledSymbolPacks.description: Symbol pack ids shown in the IDE symbol library. Missing means all packs

AuthMode.title: AuthMode
AuthMode.description: none: no login, anyone who reaches the runtime can read and write. login: every user must log in

DatasourceConfig.title: DatasourceConfig
DatasourceConfig.description: Driver-specific connection config. Fields used depend on 'type'.

certCheck.description: How the server's certificate is checked (https REST, ssl MQTT, OPC UA with security). Missing keeps the driver's old behavior: REST off, MQTT trusted, OPC UA off

certFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server certificate, for certCheck 'pinned' (hex, colons optional)

CertCheck.title: CertCheck
CertCheck.description: off: accept any certificate; pinned: only the one with certFingerprint; trusted: certificates the system trusts

backgroundColor.description: CSS color for the page background

visibleBinding.description: BOOL tag — widget hidden when value is 0/false

locked.description: IDE-only: widget cannot be moved or resized

groupId.description: IDE-only: widgets with the same groupId move together

WidgetConfig.title: WidgetConfig
WidgetConfig.description: Per-widget configuration. Fields depend on type.

decimals.description: Decimal places. Found in existing projects; not read by either app yet

fit.description: Image object-fit, as set by the properties panel

objectFit.description: Image object-fit, as set when dropped from the image library

symbolId.description: Symbol: id from a symbol pack

colorBinding.description: Tag path for color threshold evaluation

colorThresholds.description: Color threshold rules applied to colorBinding

staticText.description: TextDisplay: fixed text shown instead of a tag value

fontFamily.description: mono | sans | serif; empty means the theme font

fontSize.description: xs | sm | base | lg | xl | 2xl | 3xl | 4xl; empty means base

faceplateId.description: Faceplate widget: id of the faceplate to show

toValue.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive). If set, matches value >= value && value < toValue. If missing, matches value >= value (open-ended, highest match wins)

Dynamic.title: Dynamic
Dynamic.description: A dynamic behavior on a widget. Which fields apply depends on kind

trueColor.description: colorFill: color when the tag is truthy

falseColor.description: colorFill: color when the tag is falsy

minValue.description: rotation: tag value mapped to minAngle

maxValue.description: rotation: tag value mapped to maxAngle

writeTo.description: Action: binding to write to (may differ from binding)

expression.description: script: expression evaluated with `value` = tag value, e.g. 'value > 5000'

trueValue.description: script: applied to targetProp when the expression is truthy

falseValue.description: script: applied to targetProp when the expression is falsy

deadband.description: Default deadband in each tag's own units: a number is stored when it moves more than this from the last stored value. 0 stores any change. Text and true/false values ignore it

retentionDays.description: Days of history kept. Overrides the runtime's --history-retention

tags.description: Rules for single tags or groups; the most specific rule wins

path.description: Tag as datasource:path, e.g. 'plc1:Arp.Plc.Eclr/rTemp'. Ending in * matches every tag starting with the rest

deadband.description: Deadband for these tags; missing uses the default

store.description: false leaves these tags out of the history (default true)

driverId.description: Datasource id the tag comes from

driverAddr.description: Raw driver address of the tag

name.description: Used as {name} in bindings inside the faceplate

FaceplateWidget.title: FaceplateWidget
FaceplateWidget.description: A widget inside a faceplate. Same as Widget, but identified by localId

CanvasResolution.title: CanvasResolution
CanvasResolution.description: Screen size. 'dynamic' fills the browser window; 'fixed' uses width and height in pixels

FrameProps.title: FrameProps
FrameProps.description: Settings of the frame every widget is drawn in. Each widget type's settings include these

fontFamily.description: mono | sans | serif; empty means the theme font

fontSize.description: xs | sm | base | lg | xl | 2xl | 3xl | 4xl; empty means base

colorThresholds.description: Color threshold rules applied to colorBinding

staticText.description: TextDisplay: fixed text shown instead of a tag value

fit.description: Image object-fit, as set by the properties panel

symbolId.description: Symbol: id from a symbol pack

faceplateId.description: Faceplate widget: id of the faceplate to show

TypedProps.title: TypedProps
TypedProps.description: Ties a widget's type to the settings type its props must follow

WidgetBindings.title: WidgetBindings
WidgetBindings.description: The tags a widget reads, by slot. Values are ds:path or ns:path (faceplate widgets may use {param})

value.description: The tag the widget shows or writes

visible.description: BOOL tag: the widget is hidden while it is 0/false

color.description: Tag the frame's color thresholds read; missing means the value tag

Action.title: Action
Action.description: One thing a widget does when an event happens

tag.description: write, toggle, increment: the tag; missing means the widget's value tag

on.description: toggle: the value written when the tag is off; missing means 1 (true for a bool tag)

off.description: toggle: the value written when the tag is on; missing means 0 (false for a bool tag)

step.description: increment: the amount added; missing means 1

WidgetEvents.title: WidgetEvents
WidgetEvents.description: What a widget does when touched. onPress and onRelease write at once (momentary); onClick actions may be confirmed

DynamicV2.title: DynamicV2
DynamicV2.description: A tag-driven look on a widget (actions are events). Which fields apply depends on kind

trueColor.description: colorFill: color when the tag is truthy

falseColor.description: colorFill: color when the tag is falsy

minValue.description: rotation: tag value mapped to minAngle

maxValue.description: rotation: tag value mapped to maxAngle

expression.description: script: expression evaluated with `value` = tag value, e.g. 'value > 5000'

trueValue.description: script: applied to targetProp when the expression is truthy

falseValue.description: script: applied to targetProp when the expression is falsy

locked.description: IDE-only: widget cannot be moved or resized

groupId.description: IDE-only: widgets with the same groupId move together

FaceplateWidgetV2.title: FaceplateWidgetV2
FaceplateWidgetV2.description: A widget inside a faceplate. Same as Widget, but identified by localId

locked.description: IDE-only: widget cannot be moved or resized

groupId.description: IDE-only: widgets with the same groupId move together
